acceptance_criteria.criterion: The pure-package lint restrictions apply to all four TypeScript extensions under packages/; any exception is confined to packages/adapters or packages/ui as allowed by the specification.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The boundary checker rejects forbidden direct cross-workspace imports, including relative cross-workspace imports, while permitting only direct edges declared by §14.5 and not treating transitive reachability as permission.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: DIRECT_EDGES implements direct-edge lookup without transitive closure; validateWorkspace resolves package and relative cross-workspace imports. Automated positive, forbidden, transitive-only, and relative-import tests passed.
